newsitem.title: USA: BENTON OIL SAYS ACQUIRES JORDAN E&P RIGHTS.
newsitem.headline: BENTON OIL SAYS ACQUIRES JORDAN E&P RIGHTS.

text.p: Benton Oil and Gas Co. acquired the rights to explore for oil and natural gas with several Jordan government agencies in the country's southeastern region, the company announced Monday.
The California-based independent has agreed to buy the rights from Medallion-Huber Jordan, Inc., a joint venture between Medallion Exploration of Utah and Huber Energy of Texas.
Terms of the agreement call for Benton to pay Medallion-Huber an undisclosed fee and allow it maintain a interest in future projects.

Benton's financial commitment will be spread over three exploration periods to last about five years. "This acquisition is in keeping with our strategy to increase reserves through development as well as through low risk exploration," said A.E. Benton, chairman and chief executive officer at Benton.
The company will explore and develop about 1.2 million acres (4,827 square kilometer) of the Sirhan block known to hold light and heavy oil and gas.

Benton Oil and Gas Company, headquartered in Carpinteria, Calif., is an independent oil and gas company with operations in Venezuela, the West Siberia region of Russia, the People's Republic of China and California.
